name: Brandon Kane

text.trigger: Brandon Kane is in play and his player is not exiled.
text.vignette: A box of keepsakes turns up under the floor of the storeroom where Brandon works: locks of hair, bracelets, scraps of cloth with names written on them. He insists there is an innocent explanation, and the colony is in no mood to hear it.

options.make-him-clean-up: Brandon is placed at the Grocery Store and then dragged home: he takes 1 wound and is placed in the colony (neither counts as a move).
options.bury-the-mess: Brandon is placed at the Grocery Store (not a move) and the evidence goes in the waste pit: the last 10 item cards that left the game (survivor and event cards excepted) are added to the waste pile.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #24; Mature by our reading (a stalker with trophies). "The last 10 non-survivor, non-event cards" is read as the 10 most recently removed item cards that are not Outsiders or event-class cards.
